result.auditor_firm: A-SIT, Secure Information Technology Center – Austria
result.ca_name_from_pdf: GLOBALTRUST operated by e-commerce monitoring GmbH
result.audit_criteria: ETSI EN 319 411-1 V1.4.1 (2023-10); ETSI EN 319 401 V3.1.1 (2024-06); Baseline Requirements for the Issuance and Management of Publicly-Trusted TLS Server Certificates, version 2.1.4; Network and Certificate System Security Requirements, version 2.0.3; ETSI EN 319 403-1 V2.3.1 (2020-06); ETSI TS 119 403-2 V1.3.1 (2023-03)
qualifications: In the following areas, non-conformities have been identified throughout the audit: 6.3 Information security policy - Documentation of information security policy shall be improved to reflect all changes resulting from the takeover by the new owner. 7.9 Vulnerabilities and Incident management - Documentation of incident response and reporting procedures shall be improved to apply the incident response policy of the new owner. 7.14 Supply chain - Documentation and implementation of the register of suppliers and their agreements shall be improved. For all non-conformities, remediation has been scheduled within three months after the onsite audit at latest and will be covered by a corresponding audit.
